7560.title: ACP completion totals are emitted as context occupancy
7560.rootCauseOneLine: The Grok ACP bridge emits prompt-result inputTokens/totalTokens as exact context occupancy without a distinct live measurement.
7560.proposedFix: Verify an upstream live-occupancy signal and use it instead of completion billing totals; decide unavailable-meter behavior if that signal is absent.
7560.caveats: Fixture-level protocol reproduction repeated in two clean trusted checkouts. No live Grok installation or browser verification. UI percentage clamps to 100%. Full test patch is inline in the report; external evidence files are intentionally not published. No safe simple fix without a verified provider/product contract.
